parameters.jsCode:
const d=$json; const a=d.delivery_authorization ?? {}; const b=d.delivery_request?.response_body ?? {}; const r=b.report ?? {}; const p=b.presentation ?? {}; const m=Number(a.max_message_chars ?? 12000); const lines=[]; lines.push('*'+String(p.title ?? r.kpi_key ?? 'Revenue Report').replace(/[<>]/g,'')+'*'); if(p.summary) lines.push(String(p.summary).replace(/[<>]/g,'')); if(Array.isArray(p.key_facts)&&p.key_facts.length) lines.push('*Key facts*
'+p.key_facts.slice(0,8).map(x=>'• '+String(x).replace(/[<>]/g,'')).join('
')); const cp=r.current_period ?? {}; if(cp.value!==undefined&&cp.value!==null) lines.push('*Current value:* '+String(cp.value)+(r.currency_code?' '+r.currency_code:(r.unit?' '+r.unit:''))); const rows=p.data?.rows; if(Array.isArray(rows)&&rows.length) lines.push('*Data preview*
'+rows.slice(0,10).map(x=>JSON.stringify(x)).join('
').slice(0,5000)); const text=lines.join('

'); const valid=text.length>0&&text.length<=m&&typeof a.external_destination_id==='string'&&a.external_destination_id.length>0; return {...d,slack_payload:{text,channel_id:a.external_destination_id},delivery_payload_validation:{valid,message_length:text.length,max_message_chars:m}};
